rules.name: Perishable Expiry Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must prevent any Product Catalog item with an active expiry alert from being added to an Order Request.
rules.condition: when an Order Request is composed or updated
exceptions: items with a 'Sale' status explicitly allowing expired stock for clearance
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the Order Request and logs a compliance error for the user
rules.rationale: To ensure food safety and regulatory compliance by preventing the sale of expired perishables

parameters.name: expiry_threshold_hours
parameters.description: time window before expiry triggering an alert

rules.name: Discontinued Item Blocking
rules.statement: The system must not allow the inclusion of any Product Catalog item marked as permanently discontinued in a new Order Request.
rules.condition: when a customer or agent attempts to add an item to an order
exceptions: manual override by a senior administrator for inventory write-off purposes
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the item selection and displays a 'Product Unavailable' message
rules.rationale: To prevent revenue leakage and customer disputes regarding non-existent inventory

parameters.name: discontinuation_status
parameters.description: flag indicating permanent removal from sale

rules.name: Tax Reproducibility Mandate
rules.statement: The system must calculate tax liabilities deterministically using the exact same Order Request, Product Catalog snapshot, and Delivery Zone Map data.
rules.condition: during financial settlement and audit review
rules.if_violated: The transaction is flagged for manual reconciliation and potential regulatory penalty
rules.rationale: To ensure financial integrity and enable reproducible tax audits across jurisdictions

parameters.name: calculation_snapshot_id
parameters.description: unique identifier for the data state used in calculation

rules.name: High-Velocity Alert Scope
rules.statement: The system may only generate predictive inventory replenishment alerts for items explicitly classified as high-velocity in the Product Catalog.
rules.if_violated: Alert fatigue occurs, causing critical stockouts for key items to be missed
rules.rationale: To focus limited operational attention on items with the highest turnover and risk of stockout
